'''Lote''' [[Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation]] (MIDC) area is located in the [[Khed, Ratnagiri|Khed]] [[taluka]], in the [[Ratnagiri]] district of [[Maharashtra]] state in [[India]]. It is adjacent to [[Dhamandevi]] village. They export to the Americas and Europe.
